name: 油耗异常波动检测器（输入记录）

map.粘贴一段时期的油耗记录，自动计算平均值并标出偏离过大的异常区间，帮助发现车辆油耗: Paste a period of fuel consumption records and it automatically computes the average and flags intervals that deviate too far, revealing sudden jumps and potential faults.
map.油耗记录（每行一条：填写百公里油耗 L/100km，或填「里程 加油量」自动折算: Consumption records (one per line: enter L/100km, or "distance fuel" for automatic conversion)
map.每次加满后记录里程与加油量，下次加满再计算，避免估价误差: After each fill record the odometer and fuel quantity, then compute at the next fill to avoid estimation errors
map.固定油站与标号: Use the same station and fuel grade
map.减少油品密度与标号变化带来的波动: Reduces scatter caused by fuel density and grade changes
map.如长途、空调、拥堵、胎压异常，便于区分真实工况波动与故障: e.g. long trip, A/C use, congestion, low tire pressure, to separate real condition swings from faults
map.样本过少时均值与标准差不可靠，容易误报异常: With too few samples the mean and standard deviation are unreliable and false alarms are likely
map.冬季、短途、满载空调、胎压偏低都会抬高油耗，单点偏高属正常。真正值得警惕的是「连: Winter, short trips, full load with A/C and low tire pressure all raise consumption, so a single high reading is normal. What warrants worry is persistent deterioration of several consecutive periods above the upper bound, which usually points to carbon deposits, poor ignition, a drifting O2 sensor or dragging brakes.
map.先排除工况与胎压因素 → 检查空气滤芯与节气门积碳 → 读 OBD 看长期燃油修: Rule out conditions and tire pressure first, then check the air filter and throttle carbon, read long-term fuel trim and the O2 sensor via OBD, then the ignition system and brake drag. Following this order avoids swapping parts blindly.
map.💡 表显油耗通常比实际偏低 3%~10%，长期对比请统一使用「加油量 ÷ 区间里: 💡 The dashboard readout is usually 3%~10% optimistic, so use the measured "fuel volume ÷ interval distance" consistently for long-term comparison.
map.📚 深度解析：油耗异常波动检测器（输入记录）: 📚 In-depth: Fuel Consumption Anomaly Detector (Input Records)
map.车主粘贴一段时期的加油与里程记录，自动算平均油耗并标出偏离过大的区间，发现油耗突: Owners paste a period of refueling and mileage records; it computes the average automatically and flags outlying intervals to spot a sudden rise.
map.车队管理中，对每辆车油耗做异常筛查，定位可能存在故障（积碳、胎压低、氧传感失准）: In fleet management, screen every vehicle's consumption to find those with likely faults (carbon buildup, low tire pressure, drifting O2 sensor).
map.怀疑油品或驾驶习惯变化时，用波动检测区分偶发尖峰与持续恶化。: When fuel quality or driving habits may have changed, use fluctuation detection to tell a one-off spike from lasting deterioration.
map.12 次加油记录折算百公里油耗均值 8.22L、: Twelve refueling records give an average of 8.22L/100km with a
map.0.74L；2σ 区间≈6.73~9.70L。若某次记录 10.5L 超出上限: of 0.74L; the 2σ range ≈ 6.73~9.70L. If a record of 10.5L exceeds the 9.70L upper bound it is flagged as abnormal; judge whether that stretch was a long trip with A/C or congested city driving to decide between genuine conditions and an early vehicle fault;
map.占均值约 9%，说明日常波动本身不大，单点越界更值得关注。: about 9% of the mean, showing everyday scatter is small and any single point beyond the bound deserves attention.
map.单次油耗高就是车坏了吗？: Does one high reading mean the car is broken?
map.不一定。冬季、短途、空调满载、胎压偏低都会抬升油耗；应看记录的趋势而非单点。持续: Not necessarily. Winter, short trips, A/C at full load and low tire pressure all raise consumption; look at the trend, not one point. Only when several consecutive periods stay above 2σ with conditions ruled out should you investigate carbon deposits, ignition, the O2 sensor and brake drag.
map.记录怎么记才准？: How should I record to get accurate data?
map.每次加满至跳枪并记下里程与加油量，下次再加满时用『加油量÷区间里程×100』得区: Fill to the first click-off each time and note odometer and fuel volume; at the next fill compute "fuel volume ÷ interval distance × 100" for true interval consumption, closer to reality than the dashboard reading. Using the same station and method long-term cuts the error.
map.支持「单值」与「里程 加油量」两种格式；样本少于 8 条时统计结果参考性有限: Accepts both "single value" and "distance fuel" formats; with fewer than 8 samples the statistics are indicative only
